'''Keth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] illegally during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Keth was one of many [[Pilgrims]] who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartels]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Keth was an advocate for [[Nalen Raloch]] and considered him a great hero of the village, defending the pilgrims from the [[Flesh Raider]]s. Keth and [[Allia (Twi'lek)|Allia]] aided Raloch in his hunt for the [[Fount of Rajivari]], but eventually realized that Raloch himself had been corrupted by the knowledge he was seeking.<ref name="TOR" />
